stack: frontend http://localhost:4300 -> backend http://localhost:8090 (stable db, fresh before the browser run)

scenarios.notes: 6 nav links: URL /<page>, <page>-title visible, nav link class active

empty title -> 'Title is required.'; 201 chars -> 'Must be at most 200 characters.'; server 400 fieldErrors[title] (client validators removed via ng.getComponent) was NOT shown before F1, shown under Title after F1
dialog from empty-state button, title 'Write quarterly report', priority High -> POST 201, row tasks-row-1 with 'To do' + 'High'
task due yesterday (Africa/Cairo) shows tasks-overdue-2; no other overdue markers
tasks-edit-1: title -> 'Write Q4 report', priority Low, due 2026-10-20 -> PUT 200, row updated
tasks-complete-2 -> POST complete 200, status chip 'Done', overdue marker gone
archive 5 -> gone from default list; show-archived lists it with 'Restore'; restore -> back in default list; delete 3 + confirm-ok -> DELETE 204, row gone

q=REP (case-insensitive) -> 'Write Q4 report'; status=TODO, priority=LOW, due=OVERDUE/TODAY/THIS_WEEK/NO_DUE_DATE, sort=CREATED_ASC/DUE_DATE_ASC/DUE_DATE_DESC/CREATED_DESC all sent the right params and returned the expected rows (nulls last for due sorts)
backend stopped: alert 'The tasks could not be loaded. Try again.' + 5xx snackbar, no false empty state; backend restarted, data kept

console_errors: none in normal flows; only the deliberately provoked 400 (server field error test) and the proxy 500s while the backend was stopped
network_5xx: none in normal flows (only while the backend was deliberately stopped)
